title: Claude Code Removed Its 200-Agent Per-Session Cap
caption:
I didn't know Claude Code had a 200-agent ceiling until the release notes said it was gone.

2.1.224 removed the per-session subagent spawn cap. Concurrency and depth limits still apply, so it isn't a licence to fan out forever.

Honestly I've never come close to 200 in one session. But I like knowing the roof isn't there.

Ever hit that cap?
